name: Kuzuhara Sayaka
source:
The biggest problem child in the school.

No matter what she does, no one will oppose her out of fear of her thug of a [url=/c95411]boyfriend[/url].

She takes full advantage of her status as a high school girl to earn cash in various ways, which she then blows on having fun every day.

[Translated from [url=https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/220/article/418175]Ci-en[/url]]
